question: Select the synonym of **Insolent.**
solution:
The correct answer is: **Disrespectful**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Insolent"** means showing a rude and arrogant lack of respect. (अशिष्ट)

 
 
• **Example:** The student was insolent in his tone when speaking to the teacher, which led to disciplinary action.
 
 
 
• **"Disrespectful"** refers to behavior or attitude that shows a lack of respect or courtesy towards others. (अनादरपूर्ण)
 
 
• **Example:** Speaking loudly in a library is considered disrespectful to others who are studying.
 
 
 
• Hence, the synonym for **"Insolent"** is **"Disrespectful"**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Disrespectful**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Gentle **(मृदु): Showing kindness, calmness, or softness in behavior or action.

 
 
• **Example:** He has a gentle nature that makes him approachable and trustworthy.
 
 
 
• **Polite **(विनम्र): Behaving in a respectful and considerate manner.
 
 
• **Example:** She was polite while declining the invitation.
 
 
 
• **Courteous **(सभ्य): Polite and respectful in behavior or speech.
 
 
• **Example:** The hotel staff was courteous and made our stay comfortable.
